svg.title: Three stationary points have zero second derivative but different classifications
svg.desc: At the origin, x to the fourth has a minimum because its first derivative changes from negative to positive. Negative x to the fourth has a maximum because its first derivative changes from positive to negative. X cubed has neither a maximum nor a minimum because its first derivative is positive on both sides. In all three examples both first and second derivatives are zero at the origin, showing that a zero second derivative is inconclusive.
